findings.sentence: The strongest association involved a 113-bp deletion at chr8:44,300,221 (t = -6.17, P = 1.0 × 10 -7 ; allele frequency 0.55; n = 151; each copy associated with a haplotype-averaged CDR position approximately 300 kb nearer the array center).
findings.note: No effect size reported with this test.

findings.sentence: Total SV burden strongly tracked array length (t = 11.95), and array length accounted for associations with phenotypes such as the hypomethylated fraction, dip density, and dip spread.
findings.note: No effect size reported with this test.

findings.sentence: Contig count predicts mean 5mC and array length (t = +4.5, +6.3) and explains R² = 0.02 of burden.
findings.note: No effect size reported with this test.

findings.sentence: The chromosome-5 lead is the only one whose association weakens after adjustment (t = +5.32 → +4.09, P = 1 × 10 -6 → 4.2 × 10 -5 ), and the basis of this association remains unclear.
findings.note: No effect size reported with this test.

findings.sentence: The chromosome-8 lead is unchanged (t = -6.173 against t = -6.172) and the study-wide significant set for dip position is identical on chromosomes 8 and 5, with no locus gained (Supplementary Fig. S15); of the four chromosome-8 loci in Extended Data Table 1 the 1,868 bp insertion alone loses significance.
